Name: Jehdeiah
Summary: Son of Shubael son of Amram in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:20: Son of Shubael son of Amram in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jehdeiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
